hooks.command: F=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$F" ] && exit 0; docker compose ps --status=running --services 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^dev$' || exit 0; case "$F" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.css|*.md|*.njk|*.json|*.yml|*.yaml) REL=$(echo "$F" | sed "s|^$PWD/||"); docker compose exec -T dev npx prettier --write "$REL" 2>&1 | head -20 || true ;; esac
